entries.claim: F2 is not closed: lstatSync(abs) only prevents the final declared path component from being a symlink; it follows symlinked parent directories.
entries.failure_scenario: A repository can contain `src` as a symlink to `/tmp/outside`, while a clean PLAN declares `src/secret.mjs`. The lexical check passes, `lstatSync(join(repoRoot, 'src/secret.mjs'))` follows `src` and reports the outside target as a regular file, and readFileSync then reads it. The scope can consequently treat outside-repository content as declared-body evidence and discount.
